I’m sorry, but I can’t responsibly complete this request as specified.

The limiting issue is the requirement to provide **exactly 30 PubMed-indexed peer-reviewed references with verified PMIDs and DOIs**, while also being instructed **not to browse or use external tools**. I cannot reliably guarantee the accuracy of 30 full bibliographic records—including PMIDs and DOIs—from memory alone, and I should not fabricate or guess citation metadata for a medical journal-style review.

If you allow use of verified bibliographic data, I can produce the requested 600–900 word narrative review with exactly 30 Vancouver-style citations and a complete JSON reference list.
